jobs.description:

Location: Mölndal, Sweden
Employment Type: Full-time

You will combine technical understanding with commercial expertise to develop existing customer accounts, acquire new customers, and build long-term partnerships across industrial sectors, particularly agriculture, construction machinery, mining, and heavy material handling.
Working closely with engineering, project management, and operations teams, you will translate customer needs into business opportunities involving hardware, software, and technology services.

Develop strategic account plans and grow existing customer relationships.
Identify, approach, and acquire new OEM customers and Tier 1 suppliers.
Lead commercial negotiations, prepare proposals, and secure profitable agreements.
Develop business cases, ROI calculations, paid pilots, and proof-of-concept initiatives.
Collaborate with technical teams to ensure solutions meet customer expectations.
Monitor market trends, customer roadmaps, and competitor activities.
Maintain CRM records, sales forecasts, and account development plans.
Represent the organisation at customer meetings, trade fairs, and industry events.

Required Qualifications
At least 5 years of experience in business development, technical sales, or Key Account Management.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field.
Experience managing complex negotiations involving multiple stakeholders and closing deals.
Understanding of embedded hardware and software, with the ability to communicate technical value in commercial terms.
Fluency in English.

Nice to Have
Experience selling to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers.
An established network within agriculture, construction machinery, or related industrial markets.
Experience in electronics, embedded systems, or industrial technology sales.
Familiarity with CRM tools.
Fluency in Swedish.

Primarily office-based in Mölndal, with the flexibility to work remotely one day per week.

We are looking for a commercially driven professional with strong technical curiosity, excellent relationship-building skills, and the confidence to turn customer needs into sustainable business opportunities.

Most assignments take place at customer sites at airports across the Nordic region, although travel to other parts of the world may also be required. You can look forward to a dynamic working environment with plenty of variety and exciting challenges.
Qualifications Required:
These NDT-methods are required, EN4179, ET2, UT1, PT2
Training as an aircraft mechanic/technician or equivalent is a merit
Practical experience in aviation-related work is a merit
Good language skills in at least one Scandinavian language (Swedish, Norwegian, or Danish) You are expected to be communicative and have strong command of English, both spoken and written
Strong technical aptitude and a genuine interest in technology
Good computer skills
A valid B driver’s license is required
You are flexible and a good team player. You should be comfortable working both independently and as part of a team
Personal suitability will be a key selection factor, as we place great importance on personal qualities
Willingness to work away from home is essential
Recruitment is ongoing, and the position may be filled during the application period
Certification according to EN4179 preferred but not required

About the Position:
This is a full-time, permanent position. We can also offer hourly employment.
We apply individual salary setting. Recruitment is ongoing, so the position may be filled during the application period.
If you have any questions, please contact Johan Söderqvist. Contact details below.

Are you looking to broaden your Microsoft 365 expertise through varied customer projects? We are looking for a Microsoft 365 Specialist for permanent employment directly with our client. Join a collaborative team supporting projects ranging from SharePoint solutions and migrations to Teams adoption and Copilot initiatives. 
Bring your existing strengths, learn from your colleagues and take on greater responsibility as you develop!
Key responsibilities
Support a range of customer projects across Microsoft 365, contributing according to your expertise and developing skills in new areas.
Implement and configure Microsoft 365 solutions, including SharePoint environments and intranets, with some projects involving on-premises systems.
Contribute to migrations from existing systems to Microsoft 365, including data and file migration, target structures and environment setup.
Help customers organise and manage information within Microsoft 365, taking information security requirements into account.
Support training, user adoption and change activities for Teams, Microsoft 365 and Copilot, depending on customer needs and your specialisation.
Work closely with colleagues and customer stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver practical solutions.

Ideal candidate profile
Approximately 3-5 years of relevant experience in Microsoft 365 technical delivery
A solid foundation in SharePoint, migrations, configuration, data management or user enablement – you do not need to be an expert in all of them.
The ability to connect your technical expertise with customer needs.
An interest in continuous learning, working across different projects and gradually taking on more responsibility.
A collaborative approach, with a willingness to share knowledge and contribute complementary skills to the team.
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English, as the role involves close collaboration with both global and Swedish-speaking customers and stakeholders.

Conditions
Location: Central Stockholm.
Work model: Hybrid
Employment type: Full-time, permanent employment directly with our client.
Salary: 38 000 - 45 000
Start date: By agreement.

Recruitment steps
Initial call with a KUBO recruiter to discuss your experience, strengths and development interests.
Interview with the client (a few rounds may be required)
Decision and feedback.

If your experience is in Microsoft 365 but does not fully match the profile described above, you are still welcome to apply. We may be able to match your experience with another current or upcoming opportunity.

Are you an experienced Verification Engineer with an interest in system-level testing and embedded systems? Do you enjoy hands-on verification work and taking ownership of end-to-end functionality in complex technical environments? Then this could be an interesting opportunity for you! ALTEN is now proactively looking for Verification Engineers to clients within the automotive industry.
Main responsibilities
Perform verification on system level and/or embedded software
Develop, execute, and improve test methods and verification approaches
Perform exploratory and requirement-based testing
Work hands-on with test environments, rigs, or target platforms
Support development of simulations and test utilities
Document verification results, test methods, and quality status
Take responsibility for verification of selected end-to-end functions

Your profile
You are a structured and analytical engineer who enjoys hands-on verification and system-level problem solving. You are comfortable working in cross-functional, agile teams and take ownership of your work from planning to delivery.
We see that you have:
Experience from verification or test work in embedded systems
Experience working with Linux-based environments
Familiarity with system-level testing and verification workflows
Experience working in agile or Scrum-based development teams
Very good communication skills in English, both written and spoken

Meritorious experience
It is considered a merit if you have experience with one or more of the following:
Verification of complex or centralized ECU systems
Automotive software or embedded platforms
Test automation frameworks or scripting
Simulation tools or test environments
CI/CD pipelines, integration, or test management tools

Application
Please note, this is a proactive job advertisement intended to connect with talented professionals and does not currently refer to a specific assignment. We review applications continuously. We welcome your application!
About ALTEN
ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest engineering and IT consulting companies with over 57,000 employees in around 30 countries. Our engineers carry out advanced projects throughout the product development cycle for leading companies in sectors such as Automotive, Aerospace, Energy, and Life Sciences.
In Sweden, we are about 1,300 committed employees across 9 cities – from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north. For the fifth consecutive year, ALTEN has been recognized as one of Sweden’s most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, thanks to our strong focus on career development, innovation, and engineering excellence.
Visit www.alten.se to learn more about us.

Role Purpose
We are looking for an experienced Biomedical Scientist with strong ultrasound competency to join our clinical team in Stockholm on a part-time basis, working two days per week.
You will perform echocardiography and vascular ultrasound, interpret the findings and independently sign off reports for normal studies, as part of Neko's preventive health offering. You will work independently within a multidisciplinary clinical team. Abnormal findings are reviewed at our cardiology meeting. Your findings feed directly into each member's full health picture.
What You'll Deliver in the First 6 - 12 Months
Conduct comprehensive transthoracic echocardiography (TTE), including Global Longitudinal Strain (GLS), and vascular duplex ultrasound, in line with ESC and ESVS standards and Neko protocols.
Interpret findings and independently sign off reports for normal studies, ensuring timely delivery of results to members and referring clinicians.
Present abnormal or equivocal findings at the cardiology MDT meeting for review and sign-off.
Interpreting the ECG findings.
Collaborate with the multidisciplinary team to integrate ultrasound findings into holistic health assessments.
Participate in regular ultrasound MDT meetings.
Escalate urgent or unclear cases immediately to a cardiologist or clinical physiologist, without awaiting the meeting, in accordance with Neko's escalation protocols.
Engage in continuous professional development and contribute to the training of junior colleagues as required.

Minimum Requirements
Licensed Biomedical Scientist in clinical physiology.
At least 3 years of full-time clinical experience, including at least 3 years in ultrasound.
Proven experience performing and interpreting a wide range of echocardiograms, including GLS.
Proven experience in ECG interpretation.
Sound clinical judgement, including reliably distinguishing normal from abnormal studies and recognising when escalation is required.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings clearly to members and colleagues.
Commitment to high clinical standards and ongoing professional development.
Fluent in Swedish and proficient in English, both spoken and written.

Preferred
Dual qualification in vascular ultrasound, with the ability to perform and interpret studies independently (training is available for candidates with a strong interest in vascular ultrasound but no prior experience).
Familiarity with integrating echocardiographic data into broader health assessments or preventive health strategies.
EACVI certification for adjult transthoracic echocardiography.
Previous involvement in health technology initiatives or research projects.

Interviews are ongoing, so don’t hesitate to send in your application today!

jobs.occupation: Explore Rewarding Internal Medicine Careers in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
At Dignus Medical, we specialize in matching experienced specialists in internal medicine with high-quality career opportunities throughout Sweden. Whether you are looking for a smaller hospital setting or a larger multidisciplinary clinic, we tailor the opportunity to your experience, interests, and ambitions.
We are currently seeking EU-certified specialists in internal medicine for permanent roles within hospitals and medical centers across Sweden.
You will be involved in diagnosing and managing a wide spectrum of conditions related to internal organ systems – often working both in inpatient wards and outpatient clinics. Our clients include both regional and university-affiliated hospitals, and many positions offer opportunities to combine general internal medicine with a subspecialty (e.g. cardiology, rheumatology, nephrology, etc.).
What we offer
Permanent employment with stable and supportive workplaces
Competitive salaries and favorable working hours
Structured onboarding, relocation assistance, and integration support
Personal follow-up and guidance throughout the process
Free language training with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Requirements
EU-recognized specialist certification in internal medicine, equivalent to Swedish standards
Good communication skills in English
Willingness to learn Swedish – full support provided
Motivation to develop professionally in a new healthcare system

Why Choose Dignus Medical?
We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.
Interested in a career in Sweden?
Let’s talk! Contact us today to learn more about current openings or submit your application. We look forward to helping you take the next step in your internal medicine career.
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.
